thread:
maya (sales): Quick heads-up — AetherML asked for a pilot with Redwood for streaming embeddings + model routing. They uploaded a SIG/CAIQ PDF but left several fields blank. Need a fast vendor risk triage so sales can confirm pricing tiers.

rachel (secops): I'll triage this afternoon. Initial scan: missing answers for key lifecycle (key rotation, KMS integration), no explicit admin MFA statement, and logging retention not stated. Also check their subprocessors table.

tom (eng-arch): Technical ask: does AetherML support AWS PrivateLink or VPC peering? Also need to know if they support EKM/BYOK for inference caches — PII might flow into KV caches depending on POC.

aether-rep: Hi team! We support VPC peering today and are working on PrivateLink. EKM/BYOK for caches is not GA; we have tenant HSMs. SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 certs are available. We'll upload subprocessors and clarifications now.

rachel (secops): Thanks. Can you attach your most recent penetration test report and clarify MFA for admin accounts (is it enforced via SSO?). Also need retention windows for audit logs and whether logs are customer-segregated.

aether-rep: Pen test is available but redacted in some sections, link: https://aether.example/reports/pt-2025.pdf. Admin console requires SSO (SAML/OIDC) and org admins can enforce 2FA via IdP. Logs are tenant-scoped but retention defaults to 90 days; extended retention offered as paid addon.

sec-scan-bot: Static dependency scan result: 1 high (old bcrypt usage), 3 medium libs flagged. Container image scan: 0 critical. Full scans: https://aether.example/scans/1780502468.json

rachel (secops): Triage note: High risk: no BYOK for caches and no contractual commitment for EKM; Medium: outdated bcrypt dependency flagged — ask for remediation ETA; Low: logs retention default 90d acceptable for many, but enterprise may need 1yr. Recommend: allow POC with non-sensitive data and require written BYOK/ekm roadmap + pen-test scope before prod.

li (legal): If they promise BYOK roadmap, legal wants a milestone-based exhibit in MSA with dates and SLA for delivery. Also need subprocessors + flow-down DPA. Upload the subprocessors list to the contract folder.

maya (sales): Can someone draft a 2-line risk summary for the customer internal approval? Exec sponsor wants a short note to decide price band.

tom (eng-arch): Draft: "AetherML demonstrates baseline compliance (SOC2/ISO27001) and supports VPC peering; however EKM/BYOK for inference caches is not yet GA. Proceed with POC on anonymized data; require contractual BYOK commitment and pen-test evidence before production with sensitive data."

rachel (secops): I'll tighten: "Security summary: AetherML has SOC2/ISO27001 and tenant-scoped logging (90d). Major control gap: no customer-managed keys for inference caches; vendor to provide roadmap with contractual milestones before handling sensitive workloads. Action items: vendor to provide BYOK timeline + pen-test scope + remediation ETA for bcrypt issue. POC allowed with non-sensitive data only." :white_check_mark: 

aether-rep: We'll submit BYOK roadmap with dates and remediation timeline by EOD tomorrow. Subprocessors uploaded.

li (legal): Received subprocessors, starting DPA review. If BYOK timeline meets dates in exhibit, legal can sign off on limited-prod terms.

maya (sales): Thanks all. I'll update the deal notes and hold off on production pricing until we get BYOK exhibit. Ping me if vendor misses the EOD ETA. :pray:
